subject: Common phrases and features for statements
notes: kb/Work PB75 (2026-08-18): with no SIZE ERROR phrase, an intermediate whose new value is outside the intermediate's range sets EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW to exist 'and processing proceeds as specified in 14.6.13.1.3' — for the SDIDI carrier (decimal128) and the native receiverless lane (the Int128 escape boundary, PB69) alike, in ANY statement: an arithmetic statement's EC-SIZE handling (unchanged) or, for a condition / argument / subscript / MOVE, the generic fatal statement guard (CobolSizeError is a CobolFatalException; the binder queries the family for every non-arithmetic statement) — USE F3 / PERFORM WHEN dispatch (#4/#5), RESUME or abnormal termination (#7); with checking off the run-unit boundary terminates loudly (#8). Before: an unhandled stack trace, exit 127. NOT covered: the native carrier's Int128 overflow inside a NON-arithmetic statement (a wrapped product in a condition) — kb/Work PB91.
